+def _get_spec_search_path(
+    something: str, search_path: list[str]
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return the search path to use to determine whether ``something`` is a
+    namespace package or a plain directory.
+
+    When ``something`` is a directory without an ``__init__.py``
+    (e.g. an implicit namespace package), ``search_path`` contains the
+    directory of ``something`` itself (see ``get_python_path``). Keeping
+    that entry can make a submodule that shares its name with the
+    directory (e.g. ``a/a.py`` inside directory ``a``) shadow the
+    namespace package we are trying to resolve, so we filter it out.
+    """
+    if not os.path.isdir(something):
+        return search_path
+    something_realpath = os.path.realpath(something)
+    return [
+        entry
+        for entry in search_path
+        if os.path.realpath(entry) != something_realpath
+    ]
+
